ad_info.structure_source: library format F70 (Ingredient pouring over the product with two headlines on the sides) — structure xt-01
ad_info.reference_style: Premium studio still life: the cut star ingredient pouring a stream onto the product, two side headlines and a spec column
ad_info.angle_used: Unique mechanism: aguaje from the Amazon plus fenugreek and black maca, triple action

global_identity.color_palette: Hot fuchsia #E6177F (left headline and its figure), deep magenta #B0105E, dark plum #2B1226, bottle black #0E0E10 (right headline and spec text), bubblegum pink #FF8CC0, pale blush pink #FBE3EE, white #FFFFFF. Secondary for this variation: warm studio white #FFF8F2 background (the structure dictates a light background), aguaje red-brown scales #7A2E1B and bright orange pulp #F28C28.
global_identity.visual_style: Premium studio still-life photography with a liquid splash; the real bottle sharp and identical to the photo.
global_identity.visual_atmosphere: Fresh, natural and powerful; the fruit's pulp feels thick, juicy and real.
global_identity.graphic_language: Clean light background, generous negative space, typography-only side headlines, a plain spec column with no icons.
global_identity.text_typography: Side headlines in a very heavy condensed sans-serif (Montserrat ExtraBold / Bebas-like condensed look), uppercase; figures and specs in Poppins: bold italic for the figure, regular italic for the name.

creative_objective: Make the ingredient tangible for curious women who like natural products: the real aguaje fruit literally pours into the bottle, and the two sides explain the triple action with real doses.

art_direction.design_quality: Premium, polished, modern, scroll-stopping, professionally designed, commercially strong
art_direction.visual_hierarchy: 1) The cut aguaje and the orange stream. 2) The two side headlines. 3) The bottle receiving the stream. 4) The spec column and the hand with the glass. 5) The seal line.
art_direction.composition_style: Vertical axis in the center: fruit on top, stream down the middle, bottle at the bottom center; headlines symmetrical left and right of the stream; spec column on the far left; hand with glass on the lower right.
art_direction.spacing_and_structure: Fruit 0-33%, headlines 30-55%, bottle 55-97%; spec column on the left from 58% to 92%; wide margins and clean white space between blocks.
art_direction.lighting_and_depth: Soft studio key light from the upper left, gentle fill from the right, crisp highlights on the wet pulp, small soft contact shadow under the bottle; 100 mm lens, frontal.
art_direction.conversion_feel: The ad must feel persuasive, eye-catching, emotionally engaging, credible, elegant and commercially strong

reference_structure_analysis.layout_summary: Top: the main ingredient cut open, partially out of frame, pouring a thick stream of its juice down the center. Middle: two big two-line headlines on each side of the stream (left in color, right in black), each with a small data line under it. Left edge: a column of four technical specs (bold italic figure + italic name). Bottom: the product package receiving the stream at its top, and a hand on the right holding the prepared product.

detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: A real aguaje fruit cut open, scaly red-brown skin, thick orange pulp pouring down
'TRIPLE ACCIÓN' in black + 'Fenogreco y maca negra'
400 mg Fenogreco, 200 mg Maca negra, Vitaminas A y E, 2 cápsulas al día
Real closed bottle, the stream landing on the cap only
A woman's hand holding a clear glass of water

forbidden_additions: Price, offer, CTA button, stars or testimonials
Icons or badges next to the specs
Pulp running over the label or an open bottle

visual_prompt:
Square 1:1 premium studio still-life ad. Use the attached product image as the only source of truth for the bottle: do not redesign, replace or reinterpret it; ignore any hand or surface in that photo. If a layout reference image is attached, use it ONLY for the position of the blocks; never copy its text, brand, product, fruit or colors.

BACKGROUND: seamless warm studio white #FFF8F2, very soft vignette, no texture.

TOP (0-33% of height): a real aguaje palm fruit, oval, enlarged and cut by the top edge, seen from below, its skin made of shiny overlapping red-brown scales #7A2E1B like a reptile pattern, cut open at the bottom to reveal thick bright orange pulp #F28C28 with a fibrous yellow-orange layer. From the cut, a thick glossy stream of orange pulp-juice pours straight down the center, narrowing as it falls, with tiny realistic drips and wet highlights.

MIDDLE (30-56%): on the LEFT of the stream, a two-line headline in a very heavy condensed sans-serif, uppercase, hot fuchsia #E6177F, left-aligned: 'AGUAJE DEL' / 'AMAZONAS'; under it in Poppins Regular, hot fuchsia, smaller: '200 mg'. On the RIGHT of the stream, a two-line headline in the same heavy condensed sans-serif, uppercase, bottle black #0E0E10, right-aligned: 'TRIPLE' / 'ACCIÓN'; under it in Poppins Regular, black, right-aligned: 'Fenogreco y maca negra'.

LEFT EDGE SPEC COLUMN (58-92%, left 20% of width): four stacked pairs, black #0E0E10, left-aligned: the figure in Poppins Bold Italic and the name under it in Poppins Italic: '400 mg' / 'Fenogreco'; '200 mg' / 'Maca negra'; 'Vitaminas' / 'A y E'; '2 cápsulas' / 'al día'. No icons.

BOTTOM CENTER (55-96%): ONE closed bottle standing upright, centered under the stream, about 40% of the canvas height, label facing the camera, straight on, fully legible and never mirrored, photographic and sharp: matte black cylinder about 1.6 times taller than wide, straight sides, no neck, wide glossy hot-pink #E6177F screw cap almost as wide as the body with a small white 'VITALABH' pattern, hot-pink band on the bottom fifth, black label with the huge white 'AGUAJE', 'COMPLEX 3 EN 1', the pink banner, italic pink 'TRIPLE ACCIÓN' and the three pink-outlined boxes '200mg AGUAJE + 400mg FENOGRECO + 200mg MACA NEGRA'. The orange stream lands only on the top of the closed cap, splashing into a small crown of droplets and a few drops running down the cap's edge; the label stays completely clean. Matte, no rainbow, no prism light, no lens flare. Soft contact shadow under it.

LOWER RIGHT (60-96%, right 22% of width): a woman's hand with warm medium skin, visible knuckle creases and short natural nails, entering from the right edge and holding a clear glass of water with condensation droplets, tilted slightly toward the bottle.

VERY BOTTOM (97-99%): one small centered line in Poppins SemiBold, dark plum #2B1226: 'AGREGAR LOGO Y SELLO DE REGISTRO INVIMA RSA-0030271-2024'.

No icons, badges, price, CTA button or stars.

Do not add any text that is not listed in the EXACT VISIBLE TEXT section.

Do not add CTA buttons, prices, badges, benefits, icons, trust seals, ratings, testimonials, bottom bars, discount labels, offer boxes or extra claims unless they are explicitly listed in detected_visual_blocks or text_layers.
Preserve the translated structure exactly. Do not complete or improve the layout with additional advertising elements.
meta_policy_check: All visible text has been sanitized for Facebook/Instagram Ads compliance. Only real formula facts from the label; no body or result claims.
language_rule: All visible text inside the generated image must be written in Spanish (Colombia).
